# TASK-651: Capacity ring and reserve guard

- Kind: `implementation`

## Goal

Keep capacity samples in their own capped ring file and alert against a user-chosen comfort reserve with hysteresis; the board and get_storage_summary read the ring.

## Deliverables

- Capacity ring store
- Reserve setting, alert and board wiring

- Sources/DiskStewardCore/**

- docs/reliability/evidence/**

## Acceptance Criteria

- `AC-TASK-651-01` — Samples every 5 minutes, on wake and on demand are written to a ring file separate from the detail store (2,016 fine plus 8,760 hourly per volume, at most 4 volumes, under 1 MiB) and survive relaunch; Capacity unavailable replaces any stale value.
- `AC-TASK-651-02` — The user sets a comfort reserve in GiB, suggested from disk size and migrated from the old percentage threshold; one notification fires when free space crosses below it on two comparable samples, repeats are suppressed until free space recovers above reserve plus hysteresis, and the board shows distance to the reserve.

## Required Evidence

- `EVREQ-TASK-651-01` (regression-evidence) — Ring cap, relaunch and fault tests; fake-notification crossing and hysteresis sequence; hosted sequential board observation.
